name: Alvys
summary: Cloud-native transportation management system (TMS) for trucking carriers and freight brokers in one platform: dispatch, billing, DOT/IFTA compliance, real-time load visibility and native EDI (no third-party middleware), so new shippers connect in hours rather than weeks.
best_for: FTL trucking carriers and asset-based (hybrid) brokers with roughly 5–300 trucks (especially compliance-heavy freight like hazmat, reefer and cross-border) plus shippers running private fleets, with real back-office staff to put dispatch, billing and DOT/IFTA compliance in one system
skip_if: you're a pure-play broker without assets, you run LTL/multi-modal loads billing multiple customers per load, you need rail, air or ocean tracking, or you're a single-truck operator without back-office staff
honest_knock: Two honest boundaries. Implementation runs to weeks, the vendor's own pricing FAQ says most operations are live in under two to four weeks, and real-time support is the top tier's: self-serve on Foundations, chat and email on Growth, phone and a dedicated success manager only on Scale. And it's built specifically for truck-based FTL operations: if you're a pure-play (non-asset) broker, run LTL with multiple customers per load, or need rail/air/ocean tracking, this isn't your TMS: Alvys itself is refreshingly explicit about that. The fit is narrow and deep, not broad.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 23 Nov 2026; first read with tiers 20 Sep 2026) The pricing page is public again, and it has tiers now. On 26 August 2026 alvys.com/pricing answered an ordinary request with HTTP 401 and sat behind a password; read on 20 September 2026 it returns 200 and shows three plans — Foundations, Growth and Scale — none of which carries an amount. All three read "Quoted based on volume of loads", under the page's own summary line: simple per-load pricing, free implementation, cancel anytime. Foundations now has a 14-day free trial behind a Try for free button; Growth and Scale route to sales. The FAQ states there are no setup fees, no per-user or per-seat charge, no contracts and month-to-month cancellation. Two extras are priced in the open: EDI includes 2 trading partners on Growth and 5 on Scale with per-partner pricing above the cap, and (on 20 September) the developer sandbox was a $100/month add-on on Foundations and Growth, included on Scale. Custom reports, scheduled reports, Insights AI analytics, Sage and Samsara Premium are add-ons on every tier. Read again on 23 November 2026: all three plans still say "Quoted based on volume of loads" and the FAQ still rules out setup fees and per-seat charges, but the $100/month developer-sandbox figure is no longer printed anywhere on the page, so treat it as a September reading. New in the comparison table: an AI chat allowance of 250K, 5M and 20M credits a month on Foundations, Growth and Scale with overage at $10.00 per 1M, marked Coming Soon; subsidiaries and offices are capped at 1, 3 and unlimited. The last published load-based rates (2026) were Carrier from ~$150/mo and Broker from ~$300/mo; those tier names no longer exist on the page and the figures are history, not a quote.
